_comment: The one list of byte patterns a Pulp release artifact must not contain. tools/cmake/PulpReleaseArtifactScan.cmake is the only reader; AssertNoJsSymbols.cmake, AssertNoTracingSymbols.cmake, check_control_shipping_artifact.cmake and test/cmake/reload_ship_symbol_check.cmake are thin wrappers over it. Each marker names the GATES under which it is forbidden: a gate is a build condition (an option that is OFF, a profile that is stripped), and a registration site passes the gates that hold for the artifact it scans. `kind` says where the pattern is looked for: `symbol` in the demangled `nm -C` table, `string` in the printable runs of the file bytes, `dependency` in the loader table (otool -L / readelf -d / dumpbin /DEPENDENTS). Patterns are matched as plain substrings. Adding a marker is one entry here; release-artifact-forbidden-list-selftest checks its shape and release-artifact-scan-negative-control proves the scanner flags it. Every gate carries at least one `string` marker: a stripped binary has no symbol table, so a symbol-only gate would be unchecked there; the string backstop still reads the bytes.

gates.js-off: PULP_ENABLE_JS=OFF (configure option): the pulp::view-script layer (JS engine, widget bridge, scripted UI) must not be linked. Patterns are engine entry points and view-script class members; a type name in a parameter list is not evidence the engine linked.
gates.tracing-off: PULP_TRACING=OFF (configure option): the Perfetto SDK is dev-only and must never reach a shipping build.
gates.reload-ship: PULP_RELOAD_DEV_WATCHER=0 (compile definition; defaults to PULP_DEV_BUILD where tools/cmake/PulpProfiles.cmake defines it): the development filesystem watcher that auto-dlopens a rebuilt DSP image is compiled out.
gates.bridge-exec-off: PULP_BRIDGE_EXEC_ENABLED=0 (compile definition; PULP_DEV_BRIDGE_EXEC=OFF where that option exists): the shell exec/execAsync JS bridge that hands a scripted UI a /bin/sh is compiled out.
gates.dev-env-off: PULP_DEV_BUILD=0 (tools/cmake/PulpProfiles.cmake, PULP_PROFILE=release): no development environment hook (hot reload, logic-path override, frame capture, view-host test hooks) is read from the host's environment.
gates.control-stripped: production-stripped control profile (per artifact, from its control-shipping manifest): no runtime-control endpoint, capability marker, broker symbol or control library ships. String markers are at least 14 bytes, the run floor check_control_shipping_artifact.cmake extracts.
